<h1>Flitt Payment API Documentation. Explore the methods to integrate Flitt</h1>
<div class="grid cards" markdown>

-   <h2>__How to start & Testing__</h2>

    ---
    **Start** integration and **testing** without registration. Create payments using test data and determine which type of integration suits you best.
    <br/><br/>
    ![Testing](/static/img/intro/getstarted.png){ width="350"}
    <br/>
    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Getting started](/getting-started/get-started/)

    
-    <h2>__Redirect__</h2>

    ---

    **Redirect** is a good option if you want the customer to see all payment methods on a single Flitt-hosted page.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
    <br/><br/>
    ![Image title](/static/img/intro/redirect.png){ width="350" }
    <br/>
    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Redirect](/getting-started/redirect)

-    <h2>__Embedded__</h2>

    ---
    
    Integrate **Embedded** checkout if you want the customer to have a seamless process without redirections.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
    <br/><br/>
    ![Embedded checkout](/static/img/intro/embedded.png){ width="350"}
    <br/>
    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Embedded](/getting-started/embedded/)

-    <h2>__Direct__</h2>

    ---

    Use the **Direct** integration type if  bank cards need to be process on your [PCI compliant](/pcidss-compliance/) backend.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
    <br/><br/>
    ![PCIDSS Comliant](/static/img/intro/direct.png){ width="350" }
    <br/>
    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Direct](/getting-started/direct)

-    <h2>__Withdrawal__</h2>


    ---

    **Withdrawal** is a card payout which credits funds to a card previously participated in a debit transaction.
    <br><br><br>
    ![Withdrawal](/static/img/intro/payout.jpg){ width="350"}
    <br/>
